name: Nadia
source:
A beautiful foreign student, far away from home. Nadia doesn't quite understand the customs of this strange land, but she is trying her hardest to fit in.

Eastern European and adventurous, Nadia has come here to study and experience life in another country.

Always open to new adventures, Nadia will push past her fears and get involved, even if it makes her extremely uncomfortable.

[From [url=https://dumbkoala.art/MeetTheCast/info.php?name=Nadia]DumbKoala[/url]]
